selected_V_C1_functional.selection_potential: Xi[g,Phi,B;A,omega+;Hhat,K,Lambda] = int e^{-2Phi}(R+4|grad Phi|^2-1/2|Hhat|^2) + (1/(2g10^2)) int e^{-2Phi} Tr(F_A wedge *F_A) + int K wedge (dHhat - alpha_prime/4(Tr F_A wedge F_A - Tr R+ wedge R+)) + int Lambda wedge (Hhat - dB + alpha_prime/4(omega3(A)-omega3(omega+))) + OU
selected_V_C1_functional.K_constraint_Rplus_piece: + alpha_prime/4 * integral_X K wedge Tr(R+ wedge R+)
selected_V_C1_functional.C1_interpretation: the selected C1 source is the alpha-prime R+ curvature piece of Xi restricted to the alpha_1 Iwasawa support row

Hess_Xi_blocks.source: same Strominger/Heterotic flux system paper, Positive Hessian and Linearization appendix
Hess_Xi_blocks.coercivity: delta^2 Xi at a Strominger solution is >= c ||u||_{H^1}^2 on the fixed-gauge slice orthogonal to symmetries

principal_symbol_blocks.metric_dilaton: twisted Laplacian Delta^(Hhat) on symmetric 2-tensors and scalars
principal_symbol_blocks.residual_moduli: OU variance term contributes positive weights gamma_{n,k}^{-1} when present

Hess_Xi_blocks.not_yet_supplied: finite matrix blocks of Hess_Xi on the selected C1 alpha_1 source vector and the lower-order terms needed for inversion

known_tree_seed_harmonic_data.representatives: Psi_1, Psi_2, Psi_3 are orthonormal harmonic bundle-valued (0,1)-form representatives
known_tree_seed_harmonic_data.normalized_cubic: integral_X Omega wedge Tr(Psi_1 wedge Psi_2 wedge Psi_3) = 1 after rephasing
known_tree_seed_harmonic_data.limitation: this gives the rank-one E33 tree seed, not the sector-resolved Q,u,d,L,e,N,H bases or their C1 responses
